summary.text: Lola Smallwood-Cuevas, a Democrat, represents the 28th Senate District in the California State Senate.

paragraphs.text: Her official website says she earned a bachelor's degree in communications from California State University, Hayward, and began working as a journalist.
According to the same page, she was a community coordinator for SEIU Local 1877, worked at the UCLA Labor Center, and co-founded the Los Angeles Black Worker Center.
